answer: In an agent marketplace trading river maps, umber pigment, and yarrow seeds, voting power is proportional to tokens locked in escrow for 30 days, with no bonus for creating an account. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand agents gives exactly the same influence as locking them under one identity. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying their purchase price and losing access to that capital during the lock.
